leakage_controls: Calibration uses only earlier validation dates.
All games on the same date are evaluated together and cannot calibrate one another.
Metrics compare methods on the same eligible games.
No production predictions or model coefficients are changed.
interpretation: Select a calibration method only if it improves out-of-sample Brier score and log loss consistently; this single chronological audit is evidence, not proof of future performance.
selection_note: No alternative beat raw sigmoid on both Brier score and log loss; retain raw probabilities pending more data or further testing.
